#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long power[20];
int minimum_moves;

long long get_leading_digit(long long number, int &length) {
    length = 0;
    while (number >= 10) {
        number /= 10;
        length++;
    }
    return number;
}

void explore(long long current, int count) {
    if (count >= minimum_moves) return;
    if (current == 0) {
        minimum_moves = count;
        return;
    }
    int len;
    int leading_digit = get_leading_digit(current, len);
    explore(abs(current - power[len] * leading_digit), count + leading_digit * (len + 1));
    if (leading_digit - 1 > 0)
        explore(abs(current - power[len] * (leading_digit - 1)), count + (leading_digit - 1) * (len + 1));
    if (leading_digit > 1)
        explore(abs(power[len + 1] - current), count + (len + 2));
}

int main() {
    long long number;
    scanf("%lld", &number);
    power[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 18; i++) {
        power[i] = power[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    minimum_moves = 1e9;
    explore(number, 0);
    printf("%d\n", minimum_moves);
    return 0;
}
